title: Mushroom and egg hash
summary: Mushroom and egg hash is a british dinner built around medium eggs and chestnut mushrooms, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

ingredients.prepNote: beaten if the method says so

steps.instruction: Have everything for Mushroom and egg hash chopped before the pan goes on. Pat medium eggs dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook medium eggs until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook chestnut mushrooms and new potatoes until hot and lightly browned. Return medium eggs and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Mushroom and egg hash, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
steps.tip: Taste Mushroom and egg hash before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
